title: Aspirin to Prevent Preeclampsia in Women With Elevated Blood Pressure and Stage 1 Hypertension (ASPPIRE)

sections.abstract:
To determine if low dose aspirin reduces the incidence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, eclampsia, and HELLP syndrome) in pregnant women with stage 1 hypertension and elevated blood pressure.

Posted outcomes: Development of Hypertensive Disorder. timeframe=after 20 weeks gestation until 6 weeks postpartum. Aspirin=5; Placebo=4; Aspirin=15; Placebo=15
